overview_description.description: Sensity AI develops a platform for detecting and analyzing AI-generated and manipulated media across images, videos, and audio. Its platform applies multilayer forensic analysis, including pixel, audio, metadata, and file structure examination, to identify synthetic or altered digital content. The company provides tools that support media verification, digital investigations, identity verification, and fraud detection across public and private sector use cases. It also offers API, cloud-based, and on-premise deployment options that enable organizations to integrate media authenticity checks into existing workflows. Sensity AI focuses on helping organizations assess the authenticity of digital media and generate forensic reports that support investigative and verification processes.
